title: A Foundation Model for Electrodermal Activity Data
abstract: arXiv:2603.16878v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Foundation models have recently extended beyond natural language and vision to time-series domains, including physiological signals. Yet developing foundation models for electrodermal activity (EDA) remains hindered by the absence of large-scale, curated, openly accessible datasets. EDA reflects sympathetic activity and is widely used to infer cognitive load, stress, and engagement. However, few wearable devices feature EDA sensing, and the only large-scale EDA archive to date is proprietary. To address this gap, we compile EDAMAME, a collection of EDA traces from 29 public datasets comprising approximately 23,000 hours of data from 731 users. Using this collection, we train UME, the first foundation model for EDA. As a frozen feature extractor, UME outperforms generic handcrafted features and matches generalist time-series foundation models while requiring 20x fewer computational resources; fine-tuning on the downstream tasks

translated_title: 皮电活动数据的基础模型
translated_abstract: 基础模型近来已从自然语言和视觉领域扩展到时间序列领域，包括生理信号。然而，为皮电活动（EDA）开发基础模型仍受到缺乏大规模、经过整理且公开可访问的数据集的阻碍。EDA 反映交感神经活动，被广泛用于推断认知负荷、压力和参与度。然而，很少有可穿戴设备具备 EDA 传感功能，且迄今为止唯一的大规模 EDA 数据档案是专有的。为填补这一空白，我们整理了 EDAMAME，这是一个汇集了 29 个公共数据集的 EDA 信号集合，包含来自 731 名用户的大约 23,000 小时的数据。基于该数据集合，我们训练了 UME，这是首个针对 EDA 的基础模型。作为冻结的特征提取器，UME 的表现优于通用手工特征，并能与通用时间序列基础模型相媲美，同时所需的计算资源减少了 20 倍；在下游任务上进行微调后……
tldr: 该研究构建了首个大规模公开可用的 EDA 数据集 EDAMAME（汇集 29 个数据集、约 2.3 万小时、731 名用户的数据），并训练出首个皮电活动基础模型 UME，其性能媲美通用时序基础模型但计算资源需求减少 20 倍。
